value: Furry life-sim visual novel with many animated vore scenarios with furry minigts characters (also contains male pred)
You are a young mouse living in a world post “Hyperona” pandemic, which caused many creatures to get bigger in various ways (the vaccine for which makes them act erratic towards smaller creatures)

After the first “day” which plays as a linear narrative with optional encounters, the game becomes a life-sim game with cyclical daytime phases. Train your character’s attributes by studying or training to unlock new character interactions and make future escape/endurance minigames easier. Earn money to pay rent by completing a multiple-choice minigame or serving as a pred/prey at the vore center.
